escena: SCENE (craft brewery office, late afternoon, the team checks the first week of a launch campaign): in focus, a growth analyst in a plain charcoal overshirt stands on the RIGHT side and faces LEFT, leaning toward an open laptop raised on a stand at face height that sits to the analyst's LEFT; the index finger touches the laptop screen right on the rising line of a chart. The analyst's face is seen in three-quarter profile turned to the left, toward the laptop. The cool blue light of the laptop screen is the brightest thing in the frame and lifts the face and hand. A small lime-green sticky note on the laptop bezel marks the target just reached. Behind, SOFT and out of focus, brewery crates and a window with warm dusk light. 85mm f/1.8. LENS FRAMING (essential, compact): the laptop screen, the pointing finger and the face are close together inside ONE circle whose diameter is about 65% of the frame height, centred at 60% of the frame width and at 40% of the frame height — the laptop in the left half of that circle, the face in the right half. Nobody looks at the lens. No readable text or numbers on the screen, completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the dark oiled-wood edge of the tall desk right at the lens

texto.muro: a calm, evenly shadowed brick wall
